sections.title: Scalable Security Operations Center

featured.title: Continuous monitoring, accelerated response
featured.text: Accelerate your cybersecurity and optimize all your security tools. Unlike a traditional SOC, our scalable, modular offering keeps you at the forefront of security technologies.

aside.title: Benefits of Our SOC Service
aside.text: Deal with the increase in advanced cyber threats, supplement your in-house security team with our experts, and simplify the integration of new entities in a context of growth or merger.

sections.title: What SEvOC Brings to Your Organization
sections.intro: Support, operations, and evolution: a modular offering that covers the full cycle.

bullets.text: Seamless integration into your existing tools
Guidance in crisis management and remediation
Governance and production of strategic operational indicators
24/7/365 monitoring of security alerts, operated exclusively by bilingual security analysts
Implementation of a Zero Trust approach: systematic control of identity, behavior, and access
Configuration, maintenance, intelligent automation, and orchestration, with human supervision at every stage
Monitoring the threat landscape targeting your organization (threat intelligence)
Analysis, triage, and response to security incidents
Distinctive approach to mergers and acquisitions (M&A): accelerated securing of acquired environments
Creation of child tenants under the control of the parent SOC

sections.title: Services Beyond Traditional Managed Security
paragraphs: Victrix is not just a managed services provider, and SEvOC is not just another SOC. Here's what makes our SOC team so strong.

Technological expertise — Microsoft Sentinel partnership, CrowdStrike ELP partnership (only authorized French-speaking MSSP), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and management of hybrid or complex environments.

Local, rooted, human service — 100% locally operated, non-outsourced monitoring, with direct interaction between your internal teams and our security analysts assigned to your environment; customized reports, monitoring committees, and advice based on your environment's configuration.

Flexible, collaborative, and evolutive approach — continuous evolution of the security posture (guidelines, configuration review, maturity coaching) and access to the full depth of Victrix: direct support from our specialized infrastructure, cloud, governance, and network teams, with no external outsourcing.
